notes:
Status partial. The task's core ask, X71 and Y21 counts for the most recent year across all countries reporting to the WHO Mortality Database with the number of reporting countries, could not be met: the portal (platform.who.int/mortality) is an interactive app that returns no figures to a page fetch, and the downloadable files (morticd10_part6 for 2021 onward, mort_availability.zip, both updated 23 Feb 2026) are ZIP archives that neither the fetch tool nor the shell can open here. No WHO publication tabulating X71/Y21 by country was found. Everything recorded is 'reporting countries only, not a global estimate', and nothing was summed across countries, years or codes.

What was recorded instead: (1) Statistics Netherlands StatLine 7233ENG prints X71 = 99 and Y21 = 5 for 2025, provisional (2025*); figures up to 2024 are final but the fetched view showed only 2025. (2) A CSO table for Ireland 2021, read from a Dáil written answer of 7 Feb 2024: X71 = 43, Y21 = 1, printed Total 102 (every intent); blank cells are small numbers grouped for confidentiality. Graded A because it is the statistics office's table reproduced verbatim in an official record; the reviewer may prefer C for the host, and a next_task asks for the CSO's own publication. (3) Hsieh, Wang and Lu (BMJ Open 8(7): e021501), the closest thing to the asked-for tabulation: 32 OECD countries, latest three years as of April 2017, from the WHO Cause of Death Query Online (the Mortality Database's query front end). Only the Mexico (12.35 = 593/48) and Poland (7.53 = 444/59) undetermined-to-self-harm ratios are in the readable text; the per-country Table 1 and the Dryad spreadsheet need a person with a browser.

What the reviewer should check by eye: the Oireachtas page gave no visible question title in the fetched text, so 'written question 2 of 7 Feb 2024' comes from the address; the first read of that page miscounted the listed cells, the second read confirmed X71 43, Y21 1, Total 102 (the printed non-blank cells V90 1, W69 5, W70 1, W73 1, W74 50, X71 43, Y21 1 do reach 102). The CBS row labels are truncated on the page ('X71 Intent. self-harm drowning, submer..'); the values were confirmed in a second read. The BMJ Open citation details (journal, year, volume) were not on the fetched page; volume and issue come from the address and the year from the Dryad record.

Definitions: ICD-10 X71 intentional self-harm by drowning and submersion; Y21 drowning and submersion, undetermined intent; X92 assault by drowning. Both national tables and the OECD paper show that Y21 practice varies enormously (Ireland 1 Y21 beside 43 X71; Mexico 593 Y21 beside 48 X71), which is why the do_not_add_to rules forbid comparing X71 across countries on its own. Two corrections update the notes of intentional-drowning and icd-definition to point at these rows; the old values were copied verbatim from the ledger.
